input.overview: Shoppers on io-shop saw nothing wrong, but the measurements the business uses to watch the shop stopped arriving. A planned change renamed the shop's network ports to follow a naming rule used across the platform. That change also renamed the port the monitoring system collects the shop's measurements from. The monitoring setup finds that port by its name and wasn't updated to match, so it had nothing to collect. The problem has lasted {duration}, and Argus estimates its cost to the shop in takings at {customer_loss}. No one was paged, because no on-call incident was linked to this one. Argus chose not to test the suspected cause, because the only way to test it would undo a renaming that was made on purpose. Instead it proposed a fix, which is open as a draft. That fix hasn't been applied yet, so the shop's measurements aren't being collected.
